items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Ulderis is his name, and he showed me some albums and records and things this from the motion picture so and so, your solos.

ctx.x: No, it’s amazing when you think that you could be riding down the street and be listening to something old or fairly new and you probably think, you know I think I played on that.

Yeah. Somebody, a guy who puts out a little music magazine about trumpets or something, Ulderis is his name, and he showed me some albums and records and things this from the motion picture so and so, your solos. I don’t even remember them. Honest I don’t. But it’s okay. Not that they haven’t been worthwhile—
Right. Well it’s almost like I guess when asking an accountant, do you remember when you went do to work on January 4th 1960—
